topPRs.title: eth/067-068 + sep/105-106: Metal/Mode/Zora/Dust ownership handover to Conduit
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Objective

Executes the key handover of **Metal, Mode, Zora and Dust** to Conduit's designated Safes on **both mainnet and Sepolia**, transferring per chain the **L1 ProxyAdmin**, **DisputeGameFactory** and **L2 ProxyAdmin** ownership. The `SuperchainConfig` repoint and any `SystemConfig` changes are out of scope — Conduit executes those once it holds the ProxyAdmin.

Uses the multichain `TransferOwners` / `TransferL2PAOFromL1` templates from #1519 (one task per network per template, four chains each).

| Task | Network | Action | Root safe | Nonce pins (L1PAO/FUS/SC) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `eth/067-mmzd-l1-ownership-transfers` | mainnet | ProxyAdmin + DGF → `0x4a4962275DF8C60a80d3a25faEc5AA7De116A746` | L1PAO 2-of-2 | 41 / 67 / 65 |
| `eth/068-mmzd-l2pao-transfer` | mainnet | L2 ProxyAdmin → alias `0x5b5A62275DF8c60A80D3a25FAeC5aA7De116b857` | L1PAO 2-of-2 | 42 / 68 / 66 |
| `sep/105-mmzd-l1-ownership-transfers` | sepolia | ProxyAdmin + DGF → `0x34478c2eB9018d5A6487BF0440838Cd4238e8cf2` | L1PAO 2-of-2 | 54 / 74 / 68 |
| `sep/106-mmzd-l2pao-transfer` | sepolia | L2 ProxyAdmin → alias `0x45588C2Eb9018d5a6487bF0440838cd4238E9E03` | L1PAO 2-of-2 | 55 / 75 / 69 |

## Sequencing & nonces

Numbered and pinned after #1515 (eth/065 + sep/104) and #1520 (eth/066):

- **eth/066 is L1PAO-signed** → mainnet pins sit **+1** over the live values (read 2026-08-13: L1PAO=40 / FUS=66 / SC=64).
- **eth/065 / sep/104 are FOS-signed** → no coupling; Sepolia pins are the live values (L1PAO=54 / FUS=74 / SC=68).

⚠️ Note: #1514 also claims the `sep/104` slot (RECA game types) — whichever of #1514/#1515 lands second needs renumbering, but it does not affect these tasks' numbers or pins (the RECA task is not signed by the Sepolia L1PAO).

## Verification performed

- All eight L1 contracts' current owners verified on-chain == standard L1PAO of the respective network; ProxyAdmin owner slot 0 and DGF owner slot 0x33 confirmed.
- All four L2 ProxyAdmin predeploys verified owned by the aliased current L1PAO (via each chain's public L2 RPC, including Dust's Conduit RPCs).
- Dust (not in superchain-registry, chainIds 55378/55377) addresses pinned via fallback `addresses.json`, cross-checked against the Conduit contracts API (`dust-mainnet-0` / `dust-testnet-0`) and on-chain; standard SuperchainConfig confirmed via `SystemConfig.superchainConfig()`.
- Receiving Safes verified on-chain: mainnet 4-of-10 Safe v1.3.0, sepolia 1-of-1 Safe v1.3.0; alias math confirmed. Both Safes already own the corresponding chains' `SystemConfigProxy` contracts (all four on Sepolia; Metal/Mode/Dust on mainnet).
- DelayedWETH skipped by the template on all chains: no registry WETH keys for Metal/Mode/Zora, and Dust's DelayedWETH is v1.5.0 (not ownable) — fallback JSON intentionally omits the keys.
- `just simulate-stack eth 068-…` and `just simulate-stack sep 106-…` pass locally, including the domain/message-hash checks against each VALIDATION.md.

## Note for reviewers: global `ProxyAdminOwner` pin in the L2PAO configs

The stacked simulation initially failed for eth/068 / sep/106: after the L1 task executes, on-chain discovery resolves each **registry** chain's `ProxyAdminOwner` to the new owner, while Dust's fallback JSON pins the old L1PAO → `MultisigTask: safe address mismatch`. The same failure would hit signers re-simulating after the L1 task executes on-chain. Fixed by pinning `ProxyAdminOwner` globally in `[addresses]` (same pattern as eth/066): the deposits must be sent by the *previous* L1PAO regardless of who owns the L1 ProxyAdmins, since the L2 predeploys are owned by its alias. Hashes are unchanged by the pin.

## Dependencies / signing gates

- **Stacked on #1519** (template multichain support): this PR's base is #1519's branch, so the diff shows only the four task dirs and template updates flow in automatically. GitHub retargets the base to `main` when #1519 merges. If #1519's template code changes in a way that alters the built calldata, the VALIDATION.md hashes must be regenerated (re-run the simulations).
- **Governance:** the single gov post covering Dust/Mode/Metal/Zora on both networks is being finalized — the link must be recorded in the mainnet READMEs before signing (listed as a signing gate).
- Sequencing assumes #1515/#1520 execute first; READMEs document when pins must be re-verified/bumped.

topPRs.title: tasks: add nonceless (hash-once) execution via UnorderedExecutionModule
topPRs.author: maurelian
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Tasks that set `hashOnceInput` in their `config.toml` become **nonceless**: every safe in the task signs with a hash-once value (the module's canonical `deriveHashOnce` of that string) in the nonce slot instead of a pinned nonce, and execution routes through the `UnorderedExecutionModule` (`hashOnceModule` in config, must be enabled on every safe) instead of `execTransaction`. Signatures survive nonce drift and task renumbering; replay protection is per `(safe, hashOnce)` on the module. Nonce-based tasks are completely unchanged, and templates need no modifications.

Details:
- `MultisigTask`: detection, hash-once nonce sourcing (nonce state overrides rejected), module execution routing, consumed-value pre-check with a clear error, validation asserts the hash-once value was consumed instead of nonce+1, sibling data-to-sign branch. Tenderly payload and op-txverify links are skipped for nonceless tasks (module-aware variants can come later).
- `GnosisSafeHashes`: builds the EIP-712 encoding locally for Safe >=1.5.0, which removed `encodeTransactionData()`.
- `OPCMTaskBase`: nonceless tasks expect zero root-safe state diffs (module execution touches neither nonce nor storage).
- Module contract: [ethereum-optimism/optimism#22675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/22675), deployed and verified on Sepolia at `0xADcbCff796a47D468fE8C0252FBe8d856d4e63D7`.

Executed on Sepolia against fresh Safe v1.5.0 instances with the module enabled:
- `sep/105-nonceless-welcome` — single safe; task was renumbered after signing with no effect on the signature.
- `sep/106-nonceless-nested-welcome` / `sep/107-nonceless-nested-fresh` — nested: child approval and root execution both via the module; no safe nonce moved at any step.

New tests cover drift invariance (single + nested), replay rejection, and config validation; the full regression suite passes unchanged.

Part of the San Diego hackathon nonceless (hash-once) Safe execution project.

topPRs.title: Add Unichain mainnet PAO transition tasks (eth/069-070)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
Transitions the Unichain Mainnet (chainId 130) ProxyAdmin Owner to the standard OP-governed model per the [governance post](https://app.notion.com/p/oplabs/EXTERNAL-Maintenance-Upgrade-Proposal-Unichain-ProxyAdmin-Owner-Transition-to-Standard-Optimism-Go-381f153ee16281efad21c307cef7c928): eth/069 transfers the L1 `ProxyAdmin` and `DisputeGameFactory` from the Unichain 3-of-3 to the standard L1PAO (`TransferOwners`), then eth/070 moves the L2 `ProxyAdmin` predeploy to the aliased L1PAO via a portal deposit sent by the 3-of-3 (`TransferL2PAOFromL1`). Same flow as eth/063/064 on Swell, signed by the 3-of-3's `chain-governor`/`foundation`/`council` child safes. Both tasks are DRAFT until the special voting cycle and veto period complete; all addresses are sourced from the superchain-registry (links in the task docs).

Everything else on Unichain is already standard or out of scope: Guardian, Challenger and SuperchainConfig are the OP Mainnet ones, DelayedWETH is post-U16 and not ownable, and the SystemConfig owner stays with the operator per the governance post. Sepolia is covered by the same proposal but not part of this PR.

Two drive-bys: eth/065 is marked EXECUTED ([tx](https://etherscan.io/tx/0xbf75cc41981ecb8481f3b114697310490b72f96c74fcc34e33b57433b6d9e756)) — its stale READY-TO-SIGN status broke the eth stacked simulation — and `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md` step 9 now shows the correct example `From` address.

Note: the FUS/SC nonce pins overlap with #1521 (both stack after eth/066); whichever set of tasks signs second must re-pin and re-simulate.

topPRs.title: template: multichain support for TransferOwners and TransferL2PAOFromL1
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Summary

`TransferOwners` and `TransferL2PAOFromL1` previously enforced exactly one chain per task. They now accept any number of chains, all transferred to the same new owner in a single Safe transaction:

- **TransferOwners** transfers the DisputeGameFactory and L1 ProxyAdmin ownership (plus Permissioned/Permissionless DelayedWETH when present and ownable) for every chain in `l2chains`, keeping the per-chain ordering DGF → DWETHs → ProxyAdmin last.
- **TransferL2PAOFromL1** builds one `OptimismPortal.depositTransaction` per chain, forwarding `transferOwnership(aliasedNewOwner)` to each L2 ProxyAdmin predeploy.

The motivating use case is returning administrative ownership of **Mode, Metal, Zora and Dust** (mainnet and Sepolia) to their operator's designated Safes — one bundled L1 task and one bundled L2PAO task per network instead of 16 single-chain tasks. All chains in a task must share the same root `ProxyAdminOwner` safe (enforced by the existing `L2TaskBase` parent-multisig consistency check).

## Notable details

- **Chain-list snapshot**: `TransferOwners` validates each chain's SuperchainConfig against OP Mainnet/OP Sepolia's, which requires `discoverNewChain(optimism*)` — that appends the OP chain to the registry's chain list. The task chains are snapshotted **before** discovery so the transfer/validate loops can never pull OP Mainnet into the transfer set.
- **Bug fix — post-U16 DelayedWETH**: post-U16 DWETHs (v1.5.1, exactly what Mode/Metal/Zora have) no longer expose `owner()`, and the WETH98 fallback swallows the unknown selector, returning **success with empty data**. The old `_isDWETHOwnable` would `abi.decode` the empty bytes and revert the whole task. It now guards on `data.length == 32` and correctly skips the transfer.
- **Stronger validation**: `TransferL2PAOFromL1._validate` now asserts exactly one `depositTransaction` action per chain with byte-exact expected calldata and zero value (mirroring `TransferL2PAOFromL1ToEOA`), instead of being empty.
- **Backward compatible**: for a single-chain config the built actions are byte-identical — the pre-existing `TransferL2PAOFromL1` regression test (eth/008) passes unchanged.

## Example tasks (also serve as CI template-regression fixtures)

| Task | Template | Chains |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/047-transfer-owners-multichain` | TransferOwners | Mode 34443, Metal 1750, Zora 7777777, Dust 55378 |
| `test/tasks/example/eth/048-transfer-l2pao-multichain` | TransferL2PAOFromL1 | same |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/042-transfer-owners-multichain` | TransferOwners | Mode 919, Metal 1740, Zora 999999999, Dust 55377 |
| `test/tasks/example/sep/043-transfer-l2pao-multichain` | TransferL2PAOFromL1 | same |

Dust is not in the superchain registry, so its addresses are supplied per task via `fallbackAddressesJsonPath` — demonstrating registry chains and fallback chains mixed in one task. Dust's portal/SystemConfig/SuperchainConfig were resolved from its on-chain OPCM deployment tx and verified to reference the shared SuperchainConfig on both networks (`0x95703e…` mainnet, `0xC2Be75…` sepolia). The L2PAO examples use `stateOverrides` to set each chain's L1 ProxyAdmin owner to the new owner, since the template requires the L1 transfers to be executed first.

## Regression tests

Four new tests in `test/tasks/Regression.t.sol` (both templates × both networks), pinned at mainnet block `25733900` and sepolia block `11468300`, asserting root-safe calldata plus Foundation and Security Council data-to-sign hashes. Expected values were generated by running the simulations at those blocks; the calldata was independently cross-checked offline against the expected targets (8 `transferOwnership` inner calls per TransferOwners task, 4 `depositTransaction` inner calls to the four portals per L2PAO task, correct aliased owners).

Also adds a note to `docs/simulate-l2-ownership-transfer.md`: multichain tasks emit one `TransactionDeposited` event per chain and the manual L2 simulation must be repeated per chain.

## Testing

- `forge test --match-contract RegressionTest --match-test "TransferOwners_Multichain|TransferL2PAOFromL1"` — 6/6 pass (4 new + 2 pre-existing transfer tests unchanged).
- `forge build` clean under the CI profile (`deny_warnings`), `forge fmt --check` clean.
- All existing tasks referencing these templates are EXECUTED or CANCELLED, so no live task calldata is affected.
